[EN] We're not entirely sure how the durignite draws power. It seems to be akin to the eldritch shards in Frost Reach.

Personally, I think it's the result of Bahaar's power leaching into the rock.
[ES] No estamos del todo seguros de cómo el durignite obtiene su poder. Parece ser similar a los fragmentos eldritch en Frost Reach.

Personalmente, creo que es el resultado del poder de Bahaar filtrándose en la roca.
